tasks.CalculateCircumference: Calculate the circumference of the circle traced by the point on the fan blade.
tasks.CalculateDistanceTraveled: Calculate the distance traveled by the point after 30 seconds using the circumference and angular speed.
tasks.ConvertRPMtoRadPerSec: Convert the rotational speed from revolutions per minute (RPM) to radians per second (rad/s).
tasks.DetermineRevolutions: Determine the number of revolutions in 30 seconds based on RPM.
